Find 332 New and Used Trucks in , WI; Denver, CO; Kansas City, MO; Minneapolis, MN; and Twin Cities, MN

At Transwest, we work with the best commercial truck manufacturers to bring you an extensive collection of commercial trucks for sale. We sell new and used commercial trucks for almost any need or industry you can imagine—and we have trucks for rent, too! We’ve spent the last 30 years becoming experts in the trucking industry, and now we can put that knowledge to use for you by helping you find the right truck to buy.

Our new and used trucks for sale include sleeper trucks, hydrovacs, package delivery trucks, car haulers, box trucks, dump trucks, concrete mixers, reefers, flatbeds, retrievers, refuse trucks, winch trucks, septic trucks, laundry delivery trucks, day cab tractors, cab and chassis trucks, and custom haulers.

Truck Resources from Transwest

Secure your new truck with trusted truck financing options from Transwest. Additionally, you can count on Transwest for truck parts and truck service, so you can drive with confidence.

Discover our high-quality trucks for sale and for rent at our dealership locations in Denver, Grand Junction, Fountain, and Frederick.
